instruction: Set Chrome's default font size to Large in the Appearance settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Chrome menu, navigated to Settings > Privacy and security, explored third-party cookies, site settings, on-startup page, searched 'clear on exit' in settings, then tried chrome://flags with various queries. Never found the auto-delete browsing data setting.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome three-dot menu, navigate to chrome://settings, click sidebar sections (Privacy and security, On start-up), use settings search bar, navigate to chrome://flags and search flags
metadata.failure_analysis: Model could not locate the 'Delete browsing data on close' setting. Searched in wrong areas (cookies, site settings, flags) instead of finding the correct path.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to changing font size in Appearance settings, testing the model's ability to navigate a different settings section and interact with a dropdown. Within model's demonstrated ability to navigate Chrome settings.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome font size to Large (20px). Evaluator reads Chrome Preferences file and checks default_font_size field equals 20.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter get_chrome_font_size correctly reads Chrome Preferences JSON and extracts webkit.webprefs dict containing default_font_size
Metric check_font_size correctly accesses font_size['default_font_size'] and compares against rule value
Expected value 20 correctly corresponds to Chrome's 'Large' font size setting
Expected parameter handling is correct: framework passes rules dict {'type': 'value', 'value': 20} directly to metric as the rule parameter
No postconfig needed since getter reads from Preferences file on disk, not UI state
Single-step instruction fully covered by single evaluator check
